update_agents

Source: R/abm.R
update_agents.Rd

micro-simulation time-step updater

The workhorse ABM function.Within a scenario, does a single step (bi-monthly) update of the agent characteristics. A random sample of agents evaluates their economic and social utilities. Agents evaluate the optimal electricity tariff plan. This includes a dynamic tariff. 

update_agents(
  scen,
  yeartime,
  agents_in,
  prices_scen,
  social_network,
  ignore_social = FALSE,
  behavioural_model = "prospect",
  ignore_theta = TRUE,
  quiet = TRUE
)

Arguments

scen

scenario dataframe

yeartime

decimal time

agents_in

input agent dataframe

prices_scen

tariff plan price assumptions

social_network

artificial social network

ignore_social

option to ignore social effects. Default is FALSE.

behavioural_model

"prospect" (default) or "classic" or "full"

ignore_theta

defaults to TRUE

quiet

TRUE to suppress messages

Value

updated agent dataframe

Examples


#prices_scen <- set_prices(sD)
#social_network <- make_artificial_society(dep_society_1,homophily,nu=4.5)
#agents_in <- initialise_agents(sD,2019,prices_scen,social_network)
